benchmarkDenominator.warning: This is a cloned static inventory, not upstream runner parity. The full runner was not executed because upstream test-pandoc and test-pandoc-lua-engine must be built as Haskell Tasty executables from a full checkout; the current 2026-06-03 base audit found no hydrated Pandoc upstream checkout and no pandoc.cabal, pandoc-lua-engine.cabal, cabal.project, or cabal.project.freeze files under the permitted local cache/repo scope. Running Cabal would require hydrating the broad checkout plus downloading/building the Pandoc dependency graph. ghc 9.10.3 and cabal 3.12.1.0 are on PATH, but stack is not. Native PHP progress maps 749 focused Markdown/HTML/WordPress/package/CSL/YAML/OPC/doctemplate/DOCX/ODF/table-geometry/archive-compression checks.
